Context: 2. Income from house property

'Loss' under the head 'Income from house property'.In the case of let-out property, if the net income happens to be a loss, it can be set off against the income under other heads. In the case of self-occupied property, interest on borrowed capital can be set off against income under any other head, subject to a maximum of~ 30,000 or t 2 lakhs, as the case may be.
